headline: Last session: Sensex slips into red while Nifty gains 75 points; smallcaps show resilience.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 21 September.

why: Sensex slipped into the red following a volatile trading session.
Nifty 50 managed to gain 75 points despite broader market pressure.
Investor sentiment was influenced by global cues and crude oil price fluctuations.
FII activity and domestic institutional flows remained a key focus for traders.
whatHappening: Public Sector Bank chiefs are meeting the Finance Ministry regarding a three-day strike.
The market is preparing for the upcoming week with focus on support levels.
Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are being monitored by market participants.
Festive season hiring is expected to create significant job opportunities in the coming months.
